supersedes: V32 rejected owner-chat-feedback triage under COMP-REQ-179
purpose: Generate one locked-V9-only special-expression source panel that is understandable before a viewer reads any browser label. Replace V32's abstract page tabs, receiver cuffs and tether with face-primary actions and direct but compact action cues: browsing a menu choice, speaking/listening to a microphone, and receiving charge through a standard plug-and-energy connection.
v9_identity_invariants: retain the locked V9 floating-face identity: black oval eyes, one oval highlight and one diamond sparkle per eye, eye scale, spacing and baseline, nose, cheeks, thin black line weight and wide white margins
no enclosing head, hair, ears, body, helmet, headband, card, frame, text, label, colour, shading or grey
the face performs the state through brows, mouth and highlight direction before any action cue is read
action cues are compact and character-bound to the face field, never detached interface cards, and can be separated into component masks after source approval
the three states must differ in both face action and direct action cue; a viewer must not need a label or internal component name to identify the activity

state_action_brief.unlabeled_read: this character is scanning or choosing from a menu
state_action_brief.face_action: one eyebrow slightly raised, focused level brows, decisive small horizontal mouth with one tiny centred selection notch, and highlights looking toward the active choice
state_action_brief.direct_action_cue: a compact, unmistakable three-row menu mark directly above the brows, with one row clearly selected by a tiny adjacent cursor wedge; it reads as browsing choices rather than as hair, pages, dots or a crown

state_action_brief.unlabeled_read: this character is actively recording or listening to speech
state_action_brief.face_action: gently drawn-in attentive brows, a small rounded speaking mouth just open below the nose, and highlights directed toward the sound source; calm focus, never surprise
state_action_brief.direct_action_cue: one familiar minimal microphone immediately beside the mouth with two very short sound arcs travelling from the mouth toward it; the microphone is tiny, no headset, no boom, no moustache and no duplicate mouth

state_action_brief.unlabeled_read: this character is plugged in and charging
state_action_brief.face_action: soft relaxed brows, a compact restorative smile, and highlights lifted upward; quietly recovering rather than generic celebration
state_action_brief.direct_action_cue: a familiar tiny two-prong plug at the left cheek visibly connects by one short cord to a small clean lightning-energy mark above the brow; the plug, cord and bolt touch as one readable charging action

pre_generation_quality_bar: all three states remain legible in a 200x200 black-and-white crop with labels hidden
the action cue uses a familiar functional pictogram but is physically attached to the character's face field rather than presented as a detached UI widget
each state has a distinct action verb, brow pose, mouth silhouette and highlight direction
the image must leave clean component boundaries for eyes, brows, mouth, cheeks and action cues
do not use multiple whole faces or full-frame state cards as animation assets
